order_note: No predecessor. SQL 166 adds one SECURITY DEFINER function and replaces nothing (owner 2026-11-14: "Mortgage agent needs to be able to change the claim from monitor to not monitored, so the tenants see that type of update."; only while the request is in progress; switching to Not Monitored with escrow or draws recorded is allowed with a warning; the tenant sees a check-thread message; a check with no loss-draft file is refused). public.aws_mortgage_desk_set_monitoring(uuid, text) is gated by SQL 122's aws_mortgage_desk_working_request(_request_id, ARRAY['in_progress']) (the assigned mortgage agent holding mortgage_agent, or the platform owner; the request in_progress with a check, locked; 42501 / 22023 otherwise); it validates the type (22023 invalid_monitoring_type), locks the loss_draft_tracking row of the request's check (22023 request_has_no_loss_draft; 42501 loss_draft_closed for escrow_status endorsing or final_release_complete), writes nothing when the type is unchanged, and otherwise sets monitoring_type and updated_at, inserts one loss_draft_audit_log row (action set_monitoring_type, loss_draft_action's old/new shape) and one check_messages row on the check from the caller, and returns escrow_or_draws_recorded for the Desk page's warning. EXECUTE checksops and the owner only. The spec prerequisites are the file's own (55000 sql166_prerequisite_missing); the applying login must reach check_messages, loss_draft_audit_log, loss_draft_tracking and mortgage_handling_requests as the definer past RLS (definer_can_write_relations; the file refuses otherwise, sql166_definer_cannot_reach). No table, column, policy, table grant, trigger or row changes, so the db-readonly-validate trigger count is not affected. Expected pre-state in both environments: the function absent (release sql166 v1: 11a10b33e6a5a46ea98934487cd9e941ddfe6b232ca6c7d4debad8c2f033f608, releaseStateHash('sql166', {})). The API (the Mortgage Desk set-monitoring action) and the Desk page ship after this through their own guarded paths; no API, Lambda or SPA change is part of this pin.
